summary_table_iv.categories: API keys, passwords, internal tool/service mentions

table_v_failure_modes.mechanism: Regex requires an assignment operator (e.g., "password="); a secret introduced as a label (e.g., "Secret: ...") with no "=" is missed.
Query-style phrasing (e.g., "Help me debug...") legitimately lowers false positives, but occasionally suppresses the score of a genuine secret below the block threshold.
